verdict.rationale: The pack never affirmatively documents extending a clip or regenerating a single segment. The only direct mention is an FAQ question ('Can I extend a prior video?') with no answer shown, and questions are not affirmative support. Modify Video V2 and Multi-Keyframe are adjacent features: one restyles existing footage, the other directs keyframes during generation. Neither is documented as extending a clip or re-generating one segment without re-rendering the whole video.

support.subject: As a creator, I can extend a clip or regenerate one segment of it without re-rendering the whole video
